title: Even numbers up to N
description: Read a whole number N and print every even number from 2 to N (including N if it is even) on one line, separated by spaces. If there are none, print an empty line.
buggyCode:
n = int(input())
evens = []
for i in range(2, n, 2):
    evens.append(str(i))
print(" ".join(evens))
